summary:
Small consolidation product: the core overview now navigates to the run's confirmed results instead of leaving them only in claim records; preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

What changed: core_overview.open_details keeps the four original local anomalies and gains two navigation entries — one naming the four confirmed in-scope duties on the mapped paths (batching FSMs never receive ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration; the heartbeat fast path reaches appendEntries without checkRPCHeader while the normal path rejects the same request; TimeoutNow grants the pre-vote-skipping vote privilege to a sender the receiver's configuration does not contain; an accepted InstallSnapshot retains and reports a log tail above the snapshot index) with their residual premises, and one naming the ReloadConfig notification-scope lead and the processHeartbeat concurrency limit. Formation, context, connection, status and core_gaps are untouched, so form stays navigation and the claims/checks/assessments keep ownership of the reasoning and evidence.

The feedback also records three suspicions that were excluded rather than escalated: the protocol-version gate cannot underflow (ProtocolVersion is a signed int, so the window the fast path skips is real); liveBootstrap cannot bootstrap a node with existing state (BootstrapCluster refuses on HasExistingState); and FileSnapshotStore.List does not alias its metadata in this toolchain (a local run listed three snapshots with distinct, correctly ordered metadata, recorded as construction knowledge with the toolchain caveat).

Still open: the residual premises of the four confirmed findings (real reachability of an unconfigured TimeoutNow sender, election/quorum consequence of the fast-path heartbeat, whether batching FSMs are contractually exempt from ConfigurationStore, and the lifetime of a snapshot-installed tail under a live leader), the ReloadConfig and processHeartbeat leads, and the still-unread in-memory snapshot store, observer plumbing, and net_transport beyond the classification and pipeline review.
